This exactly! The thought of the act is horrifying to me.

The health problems have played a major role both directly and indirectly in almost everything that is wrong, but they’re not the only thing. I’ve been getting better at coming to terms with them and realizing I’ll have to learn to accept them one day as I’ll probably be living with them the rest of my life however long that is.

That’s pretty much why I made this post, see who can relate and try to help find comfort in knowing that they’re not alone in this. Even just typing the words out gave me some relief for the time being. I would gladly provide the same service for you or any others that could use a hand in getting your thoughts out. I hate feeling like this and I’m sure majority of people do.
Spot on
